In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], a '''battle''' was fought in the [[Corthenia system/Legends|Corthenia system]]. [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] had recently captured six [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] as a show of force against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], who responded by [[Orinda campaign|dispatching]] the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''. Before the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} arrival, Pellaeon led from his own ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought, the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']], and captured Corthenia from New Republic control.
